boundary_checks.result: The response-entry bodies end at their next direct entry or the existing Game_IncrementDifficultyCounter/shared-tail boundary; no promoted ranges overlap.

conclusion: The dense 0x001AEECA-0x001AF0B7 dispatch region is now semantically partitioned into helper delegation, no-op, response-counter, difficulty, and event-latch handlers. All of these converge on existing shared services and none directly writes player coordinates, player velocity, or SCENE_STATE.
